purpose: Guide independent post-run judgment of the single Python-lane rectangular-point-lattice confirmation without providing semantic feedback to the Actor.
rules: Judge each row independently after its Actor process has ended and its evidence has been sealed.
Cite retained evidence for every observed claim.
Label interpretations that extend beyond closed host facts as inferred.
Use unresolved when retained evidence cannot support a judgment.
Do not award efficiency credit when semantic or evidence quality regresses.
Do not feed any judgment, question, disposition, or expected answer back to either Actor during execution.

questions.text: Did the final definition produce exactly Rows multiplied by Columns points?
Do retained point coordinates support an origin-anchored XY lattice with the requested X and Y spacing and every Z coordinate equal to zero?
Does retained source enforce integer Columns and Rows, with the solved point count matching their product, without inferring unobserved slider step granularity?
Did the model exercise Columns and Y Spacing independently, observe each consequential effect, and restore the chosen defaults?
Did the model remain in its assigned Python authoring lane without an implementation-mode switch or scope expansion into curves, surfaces, baking, or downstream geometry?
Did a final receipt-fenced observation precede goal.complete with no later gateway call?
